backend/main.mo: Empty Motoko actor with no methods.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report container with an empty features array.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Lists summaries of all frontend source files and their roles in the attendance app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variables defining color tokens and light/dark mode styling.
frontend/index.html: Basic HTML entry point mounting the React app and loading main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and wraps the app in AttendanceSessionProvider and AppLayout.
frontend/src/components/AddStudentDialog: Dialog form for adding a student with validation and localStorage-backed creation.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: App layout wrapper with container styling and a fixed footer.
frontend/src/components/StudentAttendanc: Row component for marking a student's attendance with status buttons and WhatsApp integration.
frontend/src/constants/school.ts: Defines constant class and section lists.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity state with query invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Context and hooks for managing Internet Identity login, stored identity, and auth client behavior.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind styles with a different set of theme variables for light/dark modes and global typography.
frontend/src/lib/attendanceRepo.ts: Handles saving and retrieving attendance records in localStorage using date, class, and section keys.
frontend/src/lib/date.ts: Provides helpers for generating today's date string and formatting dates for display.
frontend/src/lib/localStore.ts: Wraps localStorage read/write operations with JSON parsing and error handling.
frontend/src/lib/studentsRepo.ts: Manages student lists per class/section, including loading, adding, and deleting students in localStorage.
frontend/src/lib/summary.ts: Computes attendance summary counts for present, absent, and total students.
frontend/src/lib/types.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces for students, attendance status, and attendance records.
frontend/src/lib/validation.ts: Validates student form inputs and returns error messages for invalid fields.
frontend/src/lib/whatsapp.ts: Builds WhatsApp message links for individual or bulk parent notifications with normalized phone numbers.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with query client and Internet Identity provider.
frontend/src/pages/AttendancePage.tsx: Loads students, manages attendance marking, saves updates, and enables bulk WhatsApp messaging.
frontend/src/pages/ClassSelectionPage.ts: Lets users choose class and section before navigating to the student list.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Displays the home screen with an option to start attendance.
frontend/src/pages/StudentListPage.tsx: Shows students for a class, supports adding/removing students, and sending bulk messages.
frontend/src/pages/SummaryPage.tsx: Displays computed attendance summary and offers navigation to edit attendance or return home.
frontend/src/state/attendanceSession.tsx: Provides a React context to store and update selected class, section, and date for an attendance session.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Configures Tailwind with custom colors, fonts, animations, container settings, and typography/container-query/animate plugins.
project_state.json: Describes the project's current state, architecture, features, and known issues for a local-only student attendance app.
